$description: 360shooter design tokens. Logical pixels of the 640x360 arena. Coders use only semantic (menu.*, hud.*, game.*) and component tokens, never raw palettes.

ice.$description: H-35: diamond currency and the Diamant gear set

sprite.$description: Fixed palette of the astronaut and the raygun, identical in every biome.

highlight.$description: helmet and eye shine, laser head

gear-ice-hi.$description: H-35: Diamant set, palette letter i (sprites-m8.js)

gear-ice.$description: H-35: Diamant set, letter I; also diamond currency

gear-lava.$description: H-35: Hoelle set, letter L (same as game.fire-ring)

diamond.$description: H-35: diamond count next to gold, shop header, prices; always with the diamond symbol

owned-bg.$description: H-35: shop tile GEKAUFT (with check mark), same as done-bg

selected.$description: H-35: selected shop tile / equipped item ring (2 px), plus triangle marker

flash.$description: H-14: power slot lights up once on store (200 ms), accent at 50 %

trail.$description: H-14: boss bar, lost HP piece after a hit (300 ms)

danger-dim.$description: H-14: boss bar fill while invulnerable, always with tag IMMUN and dotted frame

diamond.$description: H-35: result screen '+1'/'+3' diamonds, with the diamond symbol

ember.$description: Pyramiden: rising embers from the braziers

ward.$description: Guardian dog ward magic: fill at opacity.aura plus a dotted 1 px ring (shape, not only colour)

aura.$description: H-23: forest spirit aura. Fill at opacity.aura plus a 1 px ring at full opacity (shape, not only colour). Replaces 0x9b59b6 (2.6:1 on elf ground)

tier-0.$description: H-33: enemy tier tint step 0 = no tint (clearTint)

tier-1.$description: H-33: enemy tier tint step 1 'Glut', multiply (setTint), second cue is scale

tier-2.$description: H-33: enemy tier tint step 2 'Glut', multiply (setTint)

tier-3.$description: H-33: enemy tier tint step 3 'Glut' (stage 3 and above), multiply (setTint)

parry-fill.$description: H-33: quicktime circle fill, same glass as hud.glass

parry-circle.$description: H-33: quicktime circle edge (2 px) and its number

parry-approach.$description: H-33: shrinking approach ring (2 px), ends on the circle edge at hitAtMs

parry-perfect.$description: H-33: PERFEKT, circle turns gold, pixel star

parry-burst.$description: H-33: PARRY! shield burst ring around the astronaut (same blue as shield-ring)

parry-symbol.$description: H-37: tint of the monochrome fairy-tale symbol (sprite parry-symbols, setTint) in the circle centre; replaces the number

parry-decoy.$description: H-37: decoy circle: wavy edge (sprite parry-decoy-edge), no glass fill, no approach ring. Same colour as a real circle on purpose: shape, not colour, tells them apart

parry-hold.$description: H-37: hold circle, filled segments of the inner 8-step ring while held

parry-hold-track.$description: H-37: hold circle, empty segments of the inner ring

parry-target.$description: H-37: drag target: four corner brackets and target symbol (no circle edge, no fill)

parry-link.$description: H-37: dotted 1 px line from a drag circle to its target

parry-flag.$description: H-37: pebble trail order flag (filled tab) behind the number in hud.screen

parry-beat.$description: H-37: beat dots under the astronaut: 1 px frame empty, filled from the first beat on

pet-aura.$description: H-35: capybara aura 'warme Quelle': fill at opacity.aura plus a dotted 1 px ring and rising pet-steam puffs. Warm honey, never mint (game.aura) or ward blue: friendly, not a danger

gear-block.$description: H-35: Diamant set block: 2 px ring around the astronaut grows 16 -> 28 px in motion.duration.gear-block, no text

crit.$description: H-35: critical hit (Teufelshoerner): hit flash in this colour (setTintFill) instead of game.hit-flash, same duration.hit; no number (principle 8)

focus-dim.$description: H-41: quicktime focus layer over map tiles and boss arena deco only (not enemies, boss, attacks, astronaut, HUD). Alpha = opacity.focus-dim

parry-keyline.$description: H-41: 1 px keyline outside AND inside the 2 px phosphor edge of circle and approach ring (also decoy edge, target brackets, hold ring outer edge). The phosphor edge then always borders ink (>= 4.5:1 on every ground); the outer keyline separates the circle from light grounds

event-marker.$description: H-43: edge marker of a spawn event (swarm wedge, ring dots, pincer double arrows) and its word. Always with a 1 px event-marker-edge outline; shape and word carry the meaning, not the colour

event-marker-edge.$description: H-43: 1 px outline around every marker shape and the glass tag of the word

event-pip.$description: H-43: 3 countdown pips under the word, one goes out every announceMs/3 (switch off, no blink); empty pip = 1 px frame in event-marker

elite-edge.$description: H-43: elite outline: the enemy silhouette drawn 4 times (+-1 px x/y) with setTintFill behind the sprite. Cold on purpose: the tier tint 'Glut' is warm (tier-1..3)

elite-crown.$description: H-43: crown sprite elite-crown (7x5 + ink outline, no tint) above the head; second cue without colour

finisher.$description: H-39 (M10): boss finisher sequence (FinisherScene). Serious anime look: ink, paper, one boss colour, coral for the astronaut. Red only as a small accent, never as a large area (WCAG 2.3.1)

ink.$description: H-39: impact frame dark tone, silhouettes, panel edges, title shadow

paper.$description: H-39: impact frame light tone (setTintFill), speedlines, beam core

letterbox.$description: H-39: cinema bars top and bottom (size.finisher-letterbox each), over the full arena width

speedline.$description: H-39: radial speedlines (wedges 1 -> 2 px) towards the hit point, over bg-<boss>

title.$description: H-39: 'BEZWUNGEN!' Kapsel x4 with a 1-font-px ink shadow (title-shadow)

title-shadow.$description: H-39: hard shadow of title and finisher name, offset 1 font px (= scale px)

name.$description: H-39: name of the finishing shot (finales only, e.g. WURZELBRECHER), Kapsel x3, same shadow

beam-rim.$description: H-39: finishing beam rim (3 px each side of the core)

beam-glow.$description: H-39: outer beam band, 50 % ordered dither, no blur

cutin-band.$description: H-39: band behind the visor strip (finisher-portrait), full arena width, 2 px coral edge lines

cutin-edge.$description: H-39: 2 px edge lines above and below the cut-in band

skip-text.$description: H-39: 'TIPPEN: WEITER' Funk x1 on hud.glass, 1 px hud.line frame, arrow icon

bg-forest.$description: H-39: stage 1 to 6 colour background, batch 1 Wald (Baummonster): saturated moss green

bg-night.$description: H-39: batch 2 Wald bei Nacht (Waldgeist): night violet

bg-oasis.$description: H-39: batch 6 Pyramiden-Oase (Pharao): dark pharaoh gold

slash.$description: H-46 (M13): cut line of the laser blade (Graphics band, size.rig-slash), drawn over the boss during the hit-stop and the slow motion; counts as the main hit, not as an extra flash

slash-rim.$description: H-46: 1 px rim on both sides of the cut line (size.rig-slash-rim)

menu.$description: Own bitmap font (docs/design/assets/fonts.js -> PNG + XML for Phaser BitmapText). 7 px cap height.

hud.$description: Own bitmap font, condensed, 8 px tall.

3.$description: HUD timer and energy, gold in panels

tracking.$description: 1 font px between glyphs, times scale

lineGap.$description: font px between lines, times scale

menu-drop.$description: hard pixel shadow, offset 4/4, no blur

menu-bevel.$description: light edge top-left, dark edge bottom-right

hud-slot.$description: H-14/H-23: power slot button, fixed 40 at every k (PE-94); margin to the arena edge = round(space.2 * k) like all HUD panels

hud-slot-icon-scale.$description: H-14: upper limit of the icon scale; with the 16x16 item sprites slotIconScale gives 2 (4 px inset)

parry-radius.$description: H-33: quicktime circle radius in arena px (diameter 40, about 44 pt on iPhone), not scaled with k

parry-distance.$description: H-33: circle centre distance from the astronaut centre

parry-touch-slack.$description: H-33: extra hit tolerance around the circle for touch

parry-line.$description: H-33: stroke of circle edge and approach ring

parry-ring-start.$description: H-33: approach ring starts at radius x 2.5 and shrinks linearly to x 1 at hitAtMs

parry-symbol.$description: H-37: symbol frame 14x14 (12x12 shape + 1 px dark outline), centred in the circle, scale 1

parry-hold-r.$description: H-37: outer radius of the inner hold ring (2 px thick, 13-15), inside the circle edge (18-20)

parry-hold-segments.$description: H-37: hold ring steps, clockwise from the top, 45 deg each with a gap of 1 px

parry-target-radius.$description: H-37: drag target radius (= PARRY_RULES.dragTargetRadiusPx), brackets sit on its bounding box

parry-target-bracket.$description: H-37: arm length of each L bracket, 2 px thick

parry-target-step.$description: H-37: brackets move this far inwards once a drag circle is selected by tap (tap replacement)

parry-link-dot.$description: H-37: dotted link line, 2x2 dot every 4 px, from circle edge (r + 3) to the bracket box; follows the circle while dragging

parry-flag.$description: H-37: order flag 10x10 on the top-left of a pebble circle (box from -24/-24 to -14/-14 of the centre), digit Funk 1x

parry-beat-dot.$description: H-37: beat dot 4x4, 3 dots with gap 4, centred 24 px below the astronaut centre

parry-hint-y.$description: H-37: centre of the hint panel above the astronaut centre; panel = image x2 + 2 px padding + 1 px frame (riddle 54x54, scale 70x54), bottom edge at -75. If the top edge would come closer than 4 px to the HUD timer, the panel moves down; circles always draw above the panel

parry-hint-scale.$description: H-37: hint images (parry-scale, parry-riddle) are drawn x2 (exception to principle 3, like the boss), so the riddle is readable on the iPhone

parry-motif.$description: H-37: colour motif 16x16 left inside the PARRY! panel, gap 6 to the word

hud-timebar-h.$description: H-33: double shot time bar height, max(2, round(2k)), inside a glass strip 1 px around

hud-timebar-gap.$description: H-33: gap between chip bottom and the glass strip of the time bar

hud-petbar-h.$description: H-35: pet bar strip height (fixed like the power slots), above the slots

hud-petbar-gap.$description: H-35: gap between pet bar bottom and the top of the power slots

pet-offset-x.$description: H-35: pet stands this far beside the astronaut centre, on the side opposite the aim (switches with flipX)

pet-offset-y.$description: H-35: pet centre below the astronaut centre (feet level); bee flies at -10

shop-tile-h.$description: H-35: shop tile height (3 rows fit the panel without scrolling)

gear-preview-scale.$description: H-35: astronaut and gear in the gear window (integer scale); portrait in the player card stays 2

finisher-letterbox.$description: H-39: height of each cinema bar (top and bottom) in arena px; leaves 280 px of picture

finisher-frame-scale.$description: H-39: finale frames 320x180 and hit images 96x96 are drawn x2 (exception to principle 3, like the boss); frames fill 640x360, centred in wider arenas

finisher-portrait-h.$description: H-39: cut-in band height (finisher-portrait 160x20 x2), band centre at 50 % of the arena height

finisher-zoom.$description: H-39: camera zoom on the boss, integer steps only (1 -> 2)

finisher-shake.$description: H-39: start amplitude of the decaying shake (halves every 80 ms); none with reduceEffects

finisher-speedlines.$description: H-39: number of radial speedlines; wedge 1 px at 48 px from the hit point, 2 px at the screen edge

finisher-panel-edge.$description: H-39: ink edge of the slanted manga panels (stage 5+), slant 12 px over the panel height

finisher-title-scale.$description: H-39: 'BEZWUNGEN!' Kapsel x4, centred, top 12 px below the upper bar (y 52 at 360), same place as the name; the two never show together

finisher-name-scale.$description: H-39: finishing shot name Kapsel x3, centred, 12 px below the upper bar

finisher-skip-inset.$description: H-39: skip hint distance to the bottom-right SafeInsets corner (above the lower bar)

finisher-shard.$description: H-39: shatter block size (finisher-shards 4x4, 3 per boss)

focus-near.$description: H-41: radius around the astronaut centre; low-rank effects inside use opacity.focus-low-near, outside opacity.focus-low-far. No new particles spawn inside while the focus is on

parry-keyline.$description: H-41: ink keyline width outside and inside the parry edge (circle drawn as r+1 ink, r phosphor 2 px, r-2 ink)

event-inset.$description: H-43: distance of every marker from the left/right SafeInsets edge of the visible arena

event-top.$description: H-43: top edge of the marker frame (below energy and timer panels, at 1x HUD; scale with k like the HUD)

event-bottom.$description: H-43: bottom edge of the marker frame, measured from the bottom SafeInsets edge (above the boss bar)

event-corner.$description: H-43: markers keep this distance from the frame corners (they slide along the edge), so they never sit under the chips or the stick

event-wedge.$description: H-43: swarm wedge: 3 chevrons 24 px wide, 6 px deep, gap 2, pointing inward, centred on the edge point of the sector centre ray (sector about 30 deg)

event-arrow.$description: H-43: pincer double arrow 20x12 (two chevrons), one per side on the edge points of both group rays

event-dot.$description: H-43: ring marker: 2x2 dots every 6 px along all four edges at event-inset

event-word-gap.$description: H-43: gap between marker shape and its glass word tag (Funk x1, on the side towards the centre); ring word sits centred under the timer

event-pip.$description: H-43: countdown pip 4x2, 3 pips gap 2, 2 px under the word tag

event-slide.$description: H-43: marker slides this far inward on appear (Stepped 3); none with prefers-reduced-motion

elite-scale.$description: H-43: elite size factor, multiplied with the tier scale (1 + 0.03 per tier, max 1.15)

elite-edge.$description: H-43: elite outline offset in arena px (independent of the sprite scale)

elite-crown-gap.$description: H-43: crown bottom sits this far above the top of the (scaled) sprite, centred; crown is not scaled

rig-scale-astronaut.$description: H-46 (M13): astronaut rig (serious ~60 px version) is drawn x2 in moments and cinematics

rig-scale-boss-moment.$description: H-46: boss rig (64 px) x3 in the fight moment (moment-<BossId>)

rig-scale-boss-cinematic.$description: H-46: boss rig x4 in the batch cinematic (cinematic-<Level>); picture area 280 px between the bars

rig-ground.$description: H-46: ground line (feet of both rigs) in arena px; astronaut origin x = 170 (moment) / 160 (cinematic), boss x = 470 / 480 (in 640 px, wider arenas centre the 640 px stage)

rig-afterimages.$description: H-46: afterimage copies per moving part (budget max 4, RS-06.5); alpha from opacity.rig-afterimage-1..3

rig-slash.$description: H-46: width of the white cut line (color.finisher.slash), scaled with the boss

rig-slash-rim.$description: H-46: coral rim on each side of the cut line (color.finisher.slash-rim)

rig-fine-rotate.$description: H-46: max code rotation in deg for parts without freeRotate (RS-06.4); larger angles use the drawn poses

blink.$description: low energy, timer < 10 s, boss banner

hit.$description: white hit flash (enemies, boss bar fill)

store-flash.$description: H-14: power slot lights up once when a power is stored

trail.$description: H-14: lost-HP piece of the boss bar fades

parry-approach.$description: H-33: circle and approach ring appear at hitAtMs - 800 (not before the telegraph start)

parry-feedback.$description: H-33: PERFEKT / GUT / VERFEHLT label and circle state stay, then vanish

parry-burst.$description: H-33: PARRY! word and shield burst ring

parry-target-step.$description: H-37: brackets slide one step in (tap replacement); with prefers-reduced-motion they jump

parry-sleep.$description: H-37: 'z' rises 6 px above a head circle after a hit; with prefers-reduced-motion it stands still

parry-tilt.$description: H-37: scale in the hint panel tilts in 2 steps over this time; with prefers-reduced-motion it shows the end tilt at once

timebar-warn.$description: H-33: double shot time bar turns hud.danger below this remaining time (no blinking)

gear-block.$description: H-35: Diamant set block ring grows once

diamond-pop.$description: H-35: '+1'/'+3' diamond pops in on the result screen (4 steps); none with prefers-reduced-motion

hatch.$description: H-35: pet-hatch 3 frames once, then the pet appears

finisher-hitstop.$description: H-39: freeze of boss and astronaut on the final hit

finisher-impact.$description: H-39: one impact frame (two-tone); at most 3 light/dark pairs per second, none with reduceEffects

finisher-bars.$description: H-39: cinema bars slide in, Stepped(3)

finisher-cutin.$description: H-39: cut-in band: 120 in from the left (slanted), 360 hold, 120 out to the right

finisher-title.$description: H-39: title and name scale in x6 -> x4 (x4 -> x3) in 2 steps, no fade

finisher-shatter.$description: H-39: shatter blocks fly out and turn to ember (2 colour steps), then vanish

finisher-frame.$description: H-39: minimum hold of one finale frame; per-frame holds are listed in the brief

finisher-skip.$description: H-39: skip hint appears after skipLockMs, without fade, never blinks

focus-in.$description: H-41: focus layer and low-rank opacity go to focus values in Stepped(3); 0 with prefers-reduced-motion (jump)

focus-out.$description: H-41: back to normal after the last circle is resolved and its feedback (parry-feedback) is over; 0 with prefers-reduced-motion

focus-hold.$description: H-41: if the next circle is announced within this time after release, the focus stays on (no out/in change): at most one light change per circle phase (RI-43)

event-slide.$description: H-43: marker slides in (size.event-slide) in Stepped(3), then stands still; no blink, no pulse

event-tone.$description: H-43: length of the announce tone (3 variants, see brief); placeholder target for the audio file

rig-smear.$description: H-46 (M13): a drawn smear pose (arm, torso, legs smear, blade-arc arc1/arc2) stands 1 to 2 frames; arc1 then arc2

rig-afterimage-gap.$description: H-46: time between two afterimage copies (they show the part where it was 33/66/99 ms ago)

rig-afterimage-fade.$description: H-46: an afterimage fades out in Stepped(3)

rig-blade-step.$description: H-46: the blade grows out of the barrel (grow1 -> grow2 -> full) and retracts (full -> grow2 -> grow1 -> off) in 80 ms steps, no fade

banner-blinks.$description: H-14: BOSS KOMMT! blinks 3 times (duration.blink), then stays; no blinking with prefers-reduced-motion

dim.$description: H-14: icon of a blocked power slot

ghost.$description: H-14: silhouette icon of an empty power slot

hover.$description: Q-45: power slot hover fill (hud.accent over the glass)

blink.$description: Q-45: alpha at the low point of a blink (energy, timer, boss banner)

aura.$description: H-23: fill of the forest spirit aura (game.aura)

focus-dim.$description: H-41: alpha of the focus layer (color.game.focus-dim): ground and deco keep about 65 % brightness

focus-low-near.$description: H-41: rank 4 (pet, pet aura, armour ring, gear overlays, fire ring, coins, lasers, particles) inside size.focus-near

focus-low-reduced.$description: H-41: rank 4 everywhere when EFFEKTE REDUZIEREN is on (particles are off anyway)
